translations.web: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
translations.bsb: When he would not be dissuaded, we quieted down and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”
translations.kjv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
